about: What the mini pilot measured and the batches of phase 2 read with. tests/contracts/test_the_contract_is_frozen.py holds it.

validator_changes.why: The dollar-math check took a prose dollar amount followed on its line by an inline mark such as [1]{.fn} or by an escaped \$ for $...$ math. Prompt, vocabulary and reading keys are unchanged; stored readings are checked again for free.

Round 6 of the licensed rollout left 15 pages malformed after their retry, and none had lost text. What loses no text is now a warning: a list item or caption that continues from the page before needs no marker or binding, a table note no marker, a decoration no kind; a callout may explain a table, a paragraph may sit in a list item; a tab in a contents entry is its leader; a binding written without quotes, and a brace in a quoted value, are read as meant. The prompt and the vocabulary's classes are unchanged, so no reading key changes; stored readings are checked again for free.

8 of the free corpus's 9 malformed accounting pages had one cause: a numbered answer or an option whose whole content is the journal table (or figure, formula, listing) printed right after it, written as a list item with its marker and an empty body, then the table. Nothing is lost, so it is a warning, as page/1.2 made what loses no text. The prompt and the vocabulary are unchanged, so no reading key changes; stored readings are checked again for free. In the same version the inline segments keep a footnote marker, a superscript and a subscript apart (decision 205.a), which changes no verdict.
